items.title: Mrs. Charlotte Botney and Mrs. Bertha George McCullum Interview, 1960-10-16
items.q: But I turned all that over to George, my son.

ctx.x: Sleep through all. Did he ever compose any numbers of his own?

Who, my husband? Yeah. No. Not that I know of him. If he did, I don't remember. But, Lord, he had all kinds of music. After he died, I had a big box of music. I told him, Mama, that would have been so useful now. Oh, I know. The Lord, the Reigners. Now you don't know it. Money. My son had some of the music. Some of the copies before he died. And he used to say to me, he made me start all of his music out. And he said, put out the valuable music. He says, now, don't you let nobody take this. Someday you might need…
Well, maybe somebody got some good out of it, I hope.
